title: AI × Math 每日精选
subtitle: 自动推理、形式化证明、数学智能与基础模型。
method: 公开来源采集、历史去重、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，与历史日报核验后排除已报道事件；论文新版本、新修订及不同软件发布等可核实更新仍可入选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: Data, Numbers, and Geometry: Three Tutorials on Numerical Methods, Machine Learning, and Evaluation
items.abstract_or_text: We present three practical tutorials on numerical computation and machine learning for mathematical research, developed for the DANGER: Data, Numbers, and Geometry workshop held at the Banff International Research Station in April 2026. The first develops a numerical approach to exterior calculus from pointwise evaluations of differential forms, using a flux formulation of the exterior derivative. Examples in Euclidean space and on the sphere illustrate geometric identities, topological features, and the effects of approximation and finite precision. The second examines how mathematical structure guides neural network design through examples involving elliptic curves, quivers, and a boundary value problem. It explores how architectural choices affect learning and uses interval arithmetic to bound the residual of a trained network over the full interval of the boundary value problem. The third addresses the evaluation and presentation of machine learning results, covering performance metrics, statistical uncertainty, classification thresholds, receiver operating characteristic curves, and accessible figure design. Throughout, the tutorials distinguish numerical agreement, predictive accuracy, structural guarantees, and rigorous bounds as different forms of evidence. Each contribution can be read independently, with accompanying notebooks and exercises that allow readers to reproduce the examples and adapt the methods to other problems.
items.summary_zh: 三份面向数学研究的教程，区分数值一致性、预测准确率、结构保证和严格界，并用区间算术检验神经网络残差。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把数学机器学习中的不同证据层级明确分开，并提供可复现实验、笔记本和练习；但主要是教程，不应视为新的模型能力结果。
items.abstract_zh: 我们介绍三份面向数学研究的数值计算与机器学习实用教程，内容源自 2026 年 4 月在 Banff International Research Station 举办的 DANGER：Data, Numbers, and Geometry 工作坊。第一份教程从微分形式的点值出发，使用外微分的通量表述，发展外微分学的数值方法。欧氏空间和球面上的例子展示了几何恒等式、拓扑特征，以及近似和有限精度的影响。第二份教程通过椭圆曲线、quiver 和边值问题等例子，考察数学结构如何指导神经网络设计；它分析架构选择如何影响学习，并使用区间算术在整个边值问题区间上界定训练网络的残差。第三份教程讨论机器学习结果的评估与呈现，涵盖性能指标、统计不确定性、分类阈值、受试者工作特征曲线和无障碍图形设计。全文始终把数值一致性、预测准确率、结构保证和严格界区分为不同形式的证据。每份教程都可以独立阅读，并配有笔记本和练习，帮助读者复现实例并将方法改用于其他问题。
items.author_line: Jessica N. Howard, Yidi Qi, Tomás S. R. Silva

items.title: zkLLMPoT: Efficient Zero Knowledge Proof of Training for Large Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Auditing the claimed outcomes of large language model (LLM) training is challenging when model weights and training data are private, while cryptographically proving the full training process is prohibitively expensive at Transformer scale. We present zkLLMPoT, a zero-knowledge framework that certifies auditor-defined properties of a trained checkpoint through forward evaluation rather than verification of its optimization trajectory. zkLLMPoT includes 2 phases: 1) The trainer fixes the architecture and the model weights are committed. Then the auditor selects challenge sequences, preventing the trainer from modifying the checkpoint in response to the audit data. 2) Then the trainer proves the objective value attained by the committed model on those sequences. This formulation makes the certification cost independent of the number of training iterations, without revealing model weights or requiring access to private training data. We build on sumcheck- and lookup-based arguments to certify Transformer computations, while supporting next-token loss and task-specific audit objectives. Across four model families, operator-level benchmarks yield proving times of 41-59 seconds for 1.1-1.5B-parameter models and 131 seconds at 13B for the covered operators, with verification below half a second at a sequence length of 512.
items.summary_zh: zkLLMPoT 用零知识证明审计训练后模型在挑战序列上的目标值，在不泄露权重和私有数据的情况下给出可验证结果。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 任务、挑战序列和验证成本都定义得清楚，并报告了多模型规模下的证明与验证时间；它验证的是指定属性，不等同于证明完整训练轨迹。
items.abstract_zh: 当模型权重和训练数据均为私有时，审计大型语言模型（LLM）所声称的训练结果十分困难，而在 Transformer 规模上对完整训练过程进行密码学证明的成本又过高。我们提出 zkLLMPoT，这是一个零知识框架，通过前向评估而不是验证优化轨迹，来认证审计者定义的训练后检查点属性。zkLLMPoT 包含两个阶段：1）训练者固定架构并提交模型权重的承诺；随后审计者选择挑战序列，从而防止训练者根据审计数据修改检查点。2）训练者证明该已承诺模型在这些序列上达到的目标值。这种表述使认证成本与训练迭代次数无关，同时不泄露模型权重，也不要求访问私有训练数据。我们基于 sumcheck 和 lookup 论证来认证 Transformer 计算，并支持下一个 token 损失和特定任务的审计目标。在四个模型系列上，算子级基准显示：对于 11 亿至 15 亿参数模型，证明时间为 41—59 秒；对于 130 亿参数模型，在所覆盖算子上为 131 秒；序列长度为 512 时，验证时间低于半秒。
items.author_line: Junkai Liang, Zhanpeng Guo, Pengfei Wu, Qingni Shen, Jiaheng Zhang, Zhonghai Wu, Haiyang Xue, Shengfang Zhai

items.title: LeanPlan: Optimal Planning with LLM-Generated Heuristics and Admissibility Proofs
items.abstract_or_text: Frontier large language models (LLMs) can generate heuristic functions that guide search to achieve state-of-the-art performance in satisficing planning, where any plan is acceptable. However, these heuristics are not guaranteed to be admissible and can lead to suboptimal plans. We introduce LeanPlan, the first planning system that finds optimal plans with LLM-generated heuristics whose admissibility is machine-checked. Given a domain description and training tasks, an agentic loop uses planner feedback to iteratively improve a reusable domain-specific heuristic, its admissibility proof and the required domain assumptions. LeanPlan implements the heuristic, its proof and an efficient planner with machine-checked grounding and search in Lean 4. We evaluate LeanPlan on ten domains from the International Planning Competition and three new domains, using test tasks with up to 57 times as many objects as the training tasks. With GPT-5.6 Sol in the agentic loop, we successfully generate heuristics and admissibility proofs for all these domains. With the resulting heuristics, LeanPlan usually expands fewer states than the state-of-the-art Scorpion planner and solves more tasks overall.
items.summary_zh: LeanPlan 让 LLM 生成的启发式函数同时带有 Lean 4 机器检查的可采纳性证明，用于寻找最优规划。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 最优性由机器检查的 admissibility proof 支撑，评测覆盖 13 个规划域并测试远大于训练任务的实例；结果仍依赖 agentic loop 生成的启发式和证明。
items.abstract_zh: 前沿大型语言模型（LLM）能够生成引导搜索的启发式函数，在满足性规划中取得当前最优水平的性能，其中任意计划都可以接受。然而，这些启发式函数不保证具有可采纳性，因而可能导致次优计划。我们提出 LeanPlan，这是第一个使用 LLM 生成且其可采纳性经过机器检查的启发式函数来寻找最优计划的规划系统。给定领域描述和训练任务，一个 agentic loop 利用规划器反馈，迭代改进可复用的领域特定启发式函数、其可采纳性证明以及所需的领域假设。LeanPlan 在 Lean 4 中实现启发式函数、其证明，以及带有机器检查 grounding 和搜索的高效规划器。我们在 International Planning Competition 的十个领域和三个新领域上进行评测，测试任务中的对象数量最多是训练任务的 57 倍。使用 GPT-5.6 Sol 参与 agentic loop 时，我们为所有这些领域成功生成了启发式函数和可采纳性证明。使用所得启发式函数时，LeanPlan 通常比当前最优的 Scorpion 规划器扩展更少状态，并且总体上解决更多任务。
items.author_line: André G. Pereira, Augusto B. Corrêa, Felipe Meneguzzi, Jendrik Seipp

items.title: DHCG: Dynamic Construction of Hierarchical Collaboration Graphs for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have demonstrated strong capabilities in solving complex problems across diverse domains. Recently, the dynamic orchestration of agent systems has become an important research direction. However, existing methods suffer from limited composition, misaligned dependencies, and inflexible scale, restricting their ability to adapt to reasoning requirements during execution. To address these limitations, we reframe MAS design as a partially observable Markov decision process, in which both the composition and scale of the MAS are dynamically determined. We propose DHCG, a novel framework that coordinates three modules (Planner, Worker, and Generator) to progressively construct a dynamic hierarchical collaboration graph from scratch based on the query and evolving execution feedback. At each step, guided by feedback, the Planner generates a set of distinct and complementary roles tailored to the current reasoning needs and selectively routes relevant information to each role. It can also finalize the hierarchical collaboration graph early or progressively expand it when additional reasoning is required. We further introduce action-aware preference optimization to train the Planner to make more effective decisions when constructing hierarchical collaboration graphs. We systematically evaluate DHCG across code generation, mathematical reasoning, and domain-specific reasoning benchmarks. DHCG achieves state-of-the-art average performance among the compared methods, improving over the single-agent baseline by 13.06 points and outperforming both static and dynamic MAS baselines by 2.77-8.02 points. Additional experiments further demonstrate its generalization across different Planner backbones and unseen Worker models.
items.summary_zh: DHCG 将多智能体系统建模为部分可观测决策过程，动态构造层级协作图，并在数学推理等基准上比较不同协作策略。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 任务覆盖数学推理、代码和领域推理，报告了相对单智能体及静态/动态基线的分数差异，并检验了规划器和未见工作模型的泛化。
items.abstract_zh: 基于 LLM 的多智能体系统（MAS）已经展现出解决不同领域复杂问题的能力。近年来，智能体系统的动态编排成为重要研究方向。然而，现有方法存在组合能力有限、依赖关系错位和规模不灵活等问题，限制了其在执行过程中适应推理需求的能力。为解决这些问题，我们将 MAS 设计重新表述为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程，其中 MAS 的组成和规模都会动态确定。我们提出 DHCG，这是一种新框架，由 Planner、Worker 和 Generator 三个模块协同工作，根据查询和不断变化的执行反馈，从零开始逐步构造动态层级协作图。在每一步中，Planner 受反馈引导，生成适合当前推理需求的一组不同且互补的角色，并选择性地向每个角色路由相关信息。当需要更多推理时，它也可以提前完成层级协作图，或逐步扩展该图。我们进一步提出 action-aware preference optimization，用于训练 Planner 在构造层级协作图时做出更有效的决策。我们在代码生成、数学推理和领域特定推理基准上系统评测 DHCG。与所比较的方法相比，DHCG 的平均性能达到 state-of-the-art：相较单智能体基线提高 13.06 分，相较静态和动态 MAS 基线提高 2.77—8.02 分。额外实验还展示了它在不同 Planner 主干模型和未见 Worker 模型上的泛化能力。
items.author_line: Jie Ren, Jiakang Yuan, Chenyu Huang, Hezeer Ma, Jiayuan Fan, Tao Chen

items.title: COMPASS: Finding Where Reasoning Lives in Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Explicitly eliciting reasoning substantially improves LLM performance. Existing approaches require a predefined characterization of reasoning, whether through CoT prompt design, contrastive CoT directions, or via SAE derived reasoning features. For mathematical reasoning with verifiable answers, we show that a much simpler signal suffices, which is the correctness of the model's own direct answer attempts. This signal yields a latent direction that elicits reasoning. This direction is decodable within the activations of most attention heads, but only a small subset of them can be effectively intervened. We introduce COMPASS, an inference-time steering method that identifies these heads using a logit-space attribution score and steers their activations along the correctness direction, requiring only per-head activation statistics. Across three model families and multiple math benchmarks, COMPASS outperforms the activation-steering baselines we compare against, improves GSM8K accuracy by 16 percentage points on average, and approaches CoT accuracy with 20-70\% fewer generated tokens. Interventions transfer without re-fitting to unseen benchmarks, and ablations show that both the correctness direction and the small set of heads carrying it are necessary, with the effect concentrated in remarkably few heads.
items.summary_zh: COMPASS 从模型直接答案的正确性中提取潜在方向，并定位少量可干预注意力头，以较少 token 引导数学推理。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在三个模型系列和多个数学基准上评测，包含跨基准迁移与消融；结果表明方法接近 CoT，但不应解读为模型获得了新的数学证明能力。
items.abstract_zh: 显式诱导推理能够显著提升 LLM 性能。现有方法需要预先定义推理特征，例如 CoT 提示设计、对比式 CoT 方向或由 SAE 得到的推理特征。对于答案可验证的数学推理，我们表明，一个更简单的信号就足够了：模型自身直接作答尝试的正确性。这个信号产生一个能够诱导推理的潜在方向。该方向可以在大多数注意力头的激活中被解码，但只有其中一小部分可以被有效干预。我们提出 COMPASS，这是一种推理时 steering 方法，使用 logit 空间归因分数识别这些注意力头，并沿正确性方向 steering 它们的激活，只需要每个注意力头的激活统计。在三个模型系列和多个数学基准上，COMPASS 优于我们比较的激活 steering 基线，GSM8K 准确率平均提高 16 个百分点，并以少 20%—70% 的生成 token 接近 CoT 准确率。干预无需重新拟合即可迁移到未见基准；消融实验表明，正确性方向和承载该方向的少量注意力头都是必要的，而且效果集中在极少数注意力头上。
items.author_line: Pratyay Dutta, Kowshik Thopalli, Vivek Narayanaswamy

items.title: SCOPE: Certified Theorem Proving with a Language Model as the Policy Planner
items.abstract_or_text: In proof assistants such as Lean, a generated proof must pass machine compilation checks, so evaluation needs no human scoring. Direct generation fails on multi-step numeric propositions: a proof is valid only if every content integer is correct, so the pass rate is bounded by the k-th power of the per-integer accuracy. Controlled corruption across 2,617 reference proofs confirms this power law. SCOPE (State-Conditioned Operator Planning and Execution) enforces the natural division of labor: the model plans over an operator vocabulary, a symbolic engine executes the numerics, and a compiler renders the proof. On a 218-problem suite it certifies 191/218 (87.6%) with a 135M backbone; the 7B DeepSeek-Prover-V1.5-RL certifies 18/218 at 27.5 times the tokens and 37.5 times the wall-clock, and DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B certifies zero on a bidirectional dual suite. Multi-step thinking costs 6.12 discrete decision actions per problem and produces no natural-language thinking text. Replacing the lagged engine state in the decision frame with the current one lifts the pass rate from 117/218 to 191/218, while up-weighting the chain-end loss hurts. On the public Lean-Workbook library, 2,132 of 3,536 gradeable admissible problems certify (60.29%) with zero regression on the main suite. All readings come from a version-frozen review with independent rechecks and reverse verification. Restricting free generation and keeping decision-time information visible is a more direct route than enlarging the model.
items.summary_zh: SCOPE 将策略规划交给语言模型、数值计算交给符号引擎、证明渲染交给编译器，在 Lean 任务上以编译检查认证证明。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 证明是否成立由 Lean 编译直接判定，报告了 218 题和 Lean-Workbook 的通过率，并有独立复核与反向验证，任务边界清楚。
items.abstract_zh: 在 Lean 等证明助手中，生成的证明必须通过机器编译检查，因此评测不需要人工评分。对于多步数值命题，直接生成会失败：证明只有在每个内容整数都正确时才有效，所以通过率受每个整数准确率的 k 次方限制。对 2,617 个参考证明进行的受控破坏实验验证了这一幂律。SCOPE（State-Conditioned Operator Planning and Execution）规定了自然的分工：模型在算子词表上进行规划，符号引擎执行数值计算，编译器生成证明。一个 135M 主干模型在 218 题套件上认证了 191/218（87.6%）；7B 的 DeepSeek-Prover-V1.5-RL 认证了 18/218，所用 token 是其 27.5 倍、墙钟时间是其 37.5 倍；DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B 在双向对偶套件上认证数为 0。每题多步思考平均需要 6.12 个离散决策动作，且不产生自然语言思考文本。将决策帧中的滞后引擎状态替换为当前状态后，通过率从 117/218 提升到 191/218；提高链末损失权重反而有害。在公开 Lean-Workbook 库上，3,536 个可评分且可采纳问题中有 2,132 个得到认证（60.29%），主套件没有回归。所有结果均来自版本冻结的复核，并经过独立重新检查和反向验证。限制自由生成并保持决策时信息可见，比单纯扩大模型规模更直接。

items.title: WorldSolver: Can LLM Agents Simulate the Physical Dynamics via Solver Generation?
items.abstract_or_text: LLM-based agents are increasingly advancing scientific and engineering problem solving, with physics simulation emerging as a challenging yet practical testbed for reproducing complex physical phenomena with application in embodied AI, games and films. As the workhorse of such simulation, a solver computes how the state of a dynamic system evolves over time. Building such solvers requires physical understanding to identify appropriate models, mathematical reasoning to formulate the underlying dynamics, and software engineering to implement them as executable code, yet this capability of LLM agents remains underexplored. To this end, we introduce WorldSolver, a benchmark of 168 simulation tasks derived from physical phenomena in 61 classic computer graphics papers, spanning 7 physical domains. Each task contains a code scaffold that provides a fixed simulation environment for the scene, with the solver implementation left for the agent to complete. Specifically, we evaluate them along three dimensions: Execution Checks for successful execution, Visual Fidelity for reproducing the intended dynamic behavior in the rendered simulation, and Physical Plausibility for physics-grounded verification of the generated dynamics. Experiments on frontier agents reveal that producing executable solvers is difficult itself, and satisfying visual and physical correctness is even harder. GPT-5.6-Sol and Claude-Opus-5 perform comparatively better than the other evaluated agents, yet achieve overall scores of only 48.7% and 46.7%, respectively. WorldSolver is an early step toward agentic solver generation, and we hope it helps drive progress toward agents that can faithfully simulate the dynamic physical world. Code is available at https://github.com/sirujiang/WorldSolver.
items.summary_zh: WorldSolver 用 168 个物理模拟任务评估智能体生成可执行求解器的能力，并分别检查执行、视觉保真度和物理合理性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 评测把代码执行、动态行为和物理正确性分开，结果显示即使前沿智能体总体得分也只有约 47%—49%，对能力边界有清晰的负面证据。
items.abstract_zh: 基于 LLM 的智能体正越来越多地用于科学和工程问题求解，而物理模拟是一个具有挑战性且实用的测试场，可用于复现复杂物理现象，并应用于具身 AI、游戏和电影。作为此类模拟的核心，求解器负责计算动态系统的状态如何随时间演化。构建求解器需要物理理解来识别合适的模型，需要数学推理来表述底层动力学，还需要软件工程能力将其实现为可执行代码，但 LLM 智能体的这项能力仍缺乏研究。为此，我们提出 WorldSolver，这是一个包含 168 个模拟任务的基准，任务源自 61 篇经典计算机图形学论文，覆盖 7 个物理领域。每个任务都提供一个为场景固定的模拟环境代码框架，而求解器实现留给智能体完成。具体而言，我们从三个维度评估它们：Execution Checks 检查是否成功执行，Visual Fidelity 检查渲染模拟是否复现预期动态行为，Physical Plausibility 则对生成的动力学进行基于物理的验证。对前沿智能体的实验表明，生成可执行求解器本身就很困难，而满足视觉和物理正确性更加困难。GPT-5.6-Sol 和 Claude-Opus-5 的表现相对优于其他被评估智能体，但总体得分也只有 48.7% 和 46.7%。WorldSolver 是迈向智能体求解器生成的早期一步，我们希望它能推动构建能够忠实模拟动态物理世界的智能体。代码见 https://github.com/sirujiang/WorldSolver。
items.author_line: Siru Jiang, Yongzhe Lyu, Shuo Lu, Yubin Wang, Yuxiang Zhang, Yue Liao, Bin Wang, Jian Liang, Tieniu Tan

items.title: Reinforcement Learning for Hierarchical Reasoning Rewards: Minimax-Optimal Rates with Transformers
items.abstract_or_text: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a standard tool for post-training language models on reasoning tasks, where the policy is updated by reward feedback while exploring the space of responses. Despite its empirical success, theoretical understanding of RL post-training remains limited, in particular of why on-policy exploration combined with a neural reward model is effective. In this paper, we address this question by modeling the reward as a hierarchical function on the response space: the reward consists of infinitely many local components, each of which becomes relevant only after the preceding ones have been resolved. We show that a natural Transformer-based actor--critic algorithm, which alternates between sampling from the current KL-regularized policy, fitting a Transformer critic to the observed rewards, and updating the policy, achieves the minimax optimal rates in the query budget and in the regularization strength up to logarithmic factors, and is minimax optimal for a fixed number of prompts. In contrast, we prove that sampling from the fixed reference distribution, as in offline reward modeling, can limit regret decay to a logarithmic rate. These results show that on-policy exploration progressively zooms in on the region where the reward is concentrated, and quantify its benefit for RL post-training.
items.summary_zh: 论文为带层级奖励的 RL 后训练建立 Transformer actor–critic 理论，给出查询预算和正则强度上的 minimax 最优率。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是可检验的理论结果，明确比较 on-policy 与固定参考分布采样，并量化探索对 regret 衰减的影响；摘要未提供实验验证，因此不应当作经验性能结论。
items.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）已经成为在推理任务上对语言模型进行后训练的标准工具，其中策略通过奖励反馈更新，同时探索响应空间。尽管经验上取得成功，人们对 RL 后训练的理论理解仍然有限，尤其不清楚为什么结合 on-policy 探索和神经奖励模型会有效。在本文中，我们将奖励建模为响应空间上的层级函数：奖励由无限多个局部成分组成，每个成分只有在前面的成分得到解决后才会变得相关。我们证明，一个自然的基于 Transformer 的 actor–critic 算法——交替从当前 KL 正则化策略中采样、对观测到的奖励拟合 Transformer critic、并更新策略——在查询预算和正则化强度方面达到除对数因子外的 minimax 最优率；对于固定数量的提示，它也是 minimax 最优的。相比之下，我们证明，像离线奖励建模那样从固定参考分布采样，可能将 regret 衰减限制在对数速率。这些结果表明，on-policy 探索会逐步聚焦于奖励集中的区域，并量化了它对 RL 后训练的益处。

items.title: APOD: reasoning-guided agentic population ordinary differential equation discovery for pharmacological digital twins
items.abstract_or_text: Establishing ordinary differential equations (ODEs) describing population data is a fundamental part of mathematical modeling in pharmacology, crucial to developing digital twins. However, doing so from sparse, noisy data is a slow, expert-driven task. Existing automated methods either search a restricted model space or ignore population inter-individual variability. Here we introduce APOD (Agentic Population ODE Discovery), a language-model agent that iteratively reasons over biological knowledge and fit diagnostics in an open-ended search space to discover a population digital twin (PDT), i.e., a shared ODE system with between-subject variability. On synthetic pharmacokinetic and tumor-dynamics benchmarks, APOD recovered ground-truth structures in 94-100\% of runs, 12-fold faster in median than an established library-based search. On real cohorts it converged to valid structures, and proposed a PDT of radioligand-therapy-induced platelet dynamics that predicts thrombocytopenia from first-cycle data and simulates alternative dosing schedules that lower the predicted risk of toxicity.
items.summary_zh: APOD 让语言模型智能体在稀疏、含噪数据上结合生物学知识和拟合诊断，开放式发现带个体差异的群体 ODE。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 合成药代动力学和肿瘤动力学基准报告了 94%—100% 的真值结构恢复率及 12 倍中位速度提升，并在真实队列上给出可检验预测。
items.abstract_zh: 建立描述群体数据的常微分方程（ODE）是药理学数学建模的基础，也是开发数字孪生的重要环节。然而，从稀疏、含噪数据中完成这一工作通常缓慢且依赖专家。现有自动化方法要么搜索受限的模型空间，要么忽略个体之间的群体变异。我们提出 APOD（Agentic Population ODE Discovery），这是一个语言模型智能体，在开放式搜索空间中迭代推理生物学知识和拟合诊断，以发现群体数字孪生（PDT），即带有受试者间变异的共享 ODE 系统。在合成药代动力学和肿瘤动力学基准上，APOD 在 94%—100% 的运行中恢复了真实结构，中位速度比一个已有的基于库的搜索方法快 12 倍。在真实队列上，它收敛到有效结构，并提出了一个描述放射性配体治疗诱发血小板动态的 PDT：该模型根据第一周期数据预测血小板减少症，并模拟能够降低预测毒性风险的替代给药方案。
items.author_line: Romain Ferrara, Martin Soucail, Victor Gertner, Adil Moussali, Joris Cocquebert, Sandrine Oziel-Taieb, Julien Nicolas, Florence Gattacceca, Mihaela van der Schaar, Sébastien Benzekry

items.title: A Systematic Study of Small Language Models on Abstract Reasoning Tasks
items.abstract_or_text: Endpoint accuracy on abstract-reasoning benchmarks does not reveal whether a language model has acquired a transferable rule or fit distribution-specific regularities. We study this distinction in small language models on the ARC-TGI benchmark, which organizes abstract grid transformations into controllable task families and supports resampling, spatial shifts, and cross-benchmark transfer. Across more than 1,000 runs, we profile decoder-only, encoder--decoder, and mixture-of-experts model families under supervised fine-tuning. We examine the efficiency and stability of skill acquisition, robustness beyond the training distribution, interactions with model family and task formulation, and layer-wise attention signatures that accompany behavioral differences. Substantial in-distribution accuracy is attainable, but acquisition is sensitive to optimization and unevenly distributed across task families. Performance deteriorates sharply outside the training distribution, including when the rule is retained but grid scale changes. Greater training-set depth and breadth yield uneven gains, while the effect of additional in-context examples depends on model family. Executable-rule induction also yields correct solutions not observed under direct grid generation. On selected tasks, attention diagnostics show distinct concentration and context-dependence profiles, but do not establish general causal mechanisms. Overall, abstract-reasoning scores are conditional on the model, adaptation regime, evaluation distribution, and response format.
items.summary_zh: 系统研究小型语言模型在 ARC-TGI 抽象网格变换上的规则学习、分布外泛化和训练稳定性，并明确指出高分不等于可迁移规则。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究覆盖 1,000 多次运行、重采样、空间平移和跨基准迁移，结果对训练分布外性能给出负面证据，并避免把注意力诊断解释成因果机制。
items.abstract_zh: 抽象推理基准上的终点准确率并不能说明语言模型是否学会了可迁移规则，还是拟合了依赖分布的规律。我们在 ARC-TGI 基准上研究小型语言模型，该基准将抽象网格变换组织为可控任务族，并支持重采样、空间平移和跨基准迁移。在 1,000 多次运行中，我们分析 decoder-only、encoder–decoder 和 mixture-of-experts 模型族在监督微调下的表现。我们考察技能习得的效率与稳定性、训练分布之外的鲁棒性、模型族与任务表述之间的相互作用，以及伴随行为差异的逐层注意力特征。模型可以取得相当的分布内准确率，但习得过程对优化很敏感，而且在不同任务族之间分布不均。离开训练分布后，性能急剧下降，包括规则保持不变但网格尺度改变的情况。增加训练集深度和广度带来的收益并不均匀，而增加上下文示例的影响取决于模型族。可执行规则归纳能够产生直接网格生成中未观察到的正确解。在部分任务上，注意力诊断显示出不同的集中和上下文依赖模式，但并不能证明一般性的因果机制。总体而言，抽象推理分数取决于模型、适应方案、评测分布和响应格式。
items.author_line: Nur A Zarin Nishat, Jens Lehmann, Andrei Aioanei, Sahar Vahdati

items.title: RESOLVE: Language-Agnostic Validation of GPU Kernels Through Testing, Reduction, and Proof
items.abstract_or_text: AI systems can now write and optimize production GPU kernels, but validating them remains an important challenge. Evaluating the kernel on a few random inputs and checking that its outputs match a trusted reference kernel within numeric tolerances is not sufficient: races can cause nondeterministic behavior that fails to manifest in tests, and numeric tolerances can hide bugs and cause false positives even after extensive calibration. To address this challenge, we present RESOLVE, which combines testing and formal verification to build a comprehensive kernel validation pipeline. It operates in three steps: First, it tests for nondeterminism using binary instrumentation that perturbs execution timing to expose races. Second, an agent rewrites the candidate and reference kernels to obtain "reduced-concurrency" versions that are simpler to analyze but still produce bitwise-identical outputs in all tests. Third, the reduced kernels are formally analyzed in the F*/Pulse framework and prove that they perform the same computation on real numbers. This sidesteps the need for numeric tolerances. We show that RESOLVE can validate a broad selection of kernels using KernelBench, and prove equivalence across fused GEMMs in three state-of-the-art frameworks and languages: CUTLASS, Triton, and Gluon. It also analyzes mega-kernels, notoriously difficult to validate, and finds four previously unreported issues, including two clear bugs. We show that agents can use RESOLVE to repair the issues, with minimal performance impact, highlighting that agents can optimize aggressively when they can rigorously check their results.
items.summary_zh: RESOLVE 把竞态测试、并发约简和 F*/Pulse 形式化证明结合起来，验证 GPU kernel 的实数计算等价性，并发现四个此前未报告的问题。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 方法将数值容差之外的形式化等价性纳入 GPU kernel 验证，覆盖 CUTLASS、Triton 和 Gluon，并报告 agent 修复问题时的性能代价。
items.abstract_zh: AI 系统现在已经能够编写和优化生产级 GPU kernel，但验证这些 kernel 仍然是重要挑战。对少量随机输入运行 kernel，并检查其输出是否在数值容差内匹配可信参考 kernel，并不足够：竞态可能导致非确定性行为，而这种行为不一定在测试中出现；数值容差也可能隐藏缺陷，即使经过大量校准仍会产生误报。为应对这一挑战，我们提出 RESOLVE，将测试和形式化验证结合成完整的 kernel 验证流水线。它分三步运行：第一，使用二进制插桩扰动执行时序，以测试非确定性并暴露竞态。第二，一个智能体重写候选 kernel 和参考 kernel，得到更易分析的“约简并发”版本，同时在所有测试中仍产生逐位相同的输出。第三，在 F*/Pulse 框架中对约简后的 kernel 进行形式化分析，并证明它们在实数上执行相同计算。这绕开了对数值容差的需要。我们展示了 RESOLVE 能够在 KernelBench 上验证广泛的 kernel，并证明三个 state-of-the-art 框架和语言——CUTLASS、Triton 和 Gluon——中 fused GEMM 的等价性。它还分析了以难以验证著称的 mega-kernel，并发现四个此前未报告的问题，其中包括两个明确的 bug。我们展示了智能体可以修复这些问题，同时性能影响很小，这说明当结果能够被严格检查时，智能体可以进行激进优化。
items.author_line: Ashkan Vedadi Gargary, Guido Martínez, Sebastian Burckhardt, Gabriel Ebner, Abhinav Jangda, Madan Musuvathi, Tyler Sorensen

items.title: TRIAGE: Direction-Aware Mismatch Stabilization of Native NVFP4 Reinforcement Learning
items.abstract_or_text: Low-precision execution can substantially accelerate reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models, but discrepancies between learner and sampler execution can destabilize policy optimization. In this paper, we characterize the interaction between mismatch and the policy-gradient direction, distinguishing locally amplifying from contracting update contributions that mismatch magnitude alone cannot identify. In native NVFP4 runs, we observe an early imbalance between the two amplifying regions, favoring negative-advantage, negative-gap updates. Their tail tokens become concentrated in a small fraction of response segments before mismatch spreads globally. Motivated by these findings, we introduce TRIAGE, a direction-aware stabilization method that uses segment-level diagnosis to selectively rebalance policy-gradient updates and applies bounded repair to residual severe mismatch. TRIAGE modifies the optimization objective while retaining native NVFP4 weight-and activation 4-bit (W4A4) forward execution on both the sampler and learner. Experiments on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-30B-A3B show stable optimization throughout the evaluated training horizon and achieve full precision level performance across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, while native NVFP4 with TRIAGE provides up to 2.3x higher rollout throughput than BF16.
items.summary_zh: TRIAGE 分析 NVFP4 低精度 RL 中的方向性误差放大，按片段重平衡策略梯度，并在数学推理基准上恢复全精度水平。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 论文把执行不匹配与策略梯度方向联系起来，报告 Qwen3 模型、五个数学推理基准和最高 2.3 倍 rollout 吞吐提升；仍属于经验性稳定化结果。
items.abstract_zh: 低精度执行可以显著加速大型语言模型的强化学习（RL），但 learner 与 sampler 执行之间的不一致会使策略优化不稳定。在本文中，我们刻画不匹配与策略梯度方向之间的相互作用，区分局部放大和收缩的更新成分，而仅凭不匹配幅度无法识别这两者。在原生 NVFP4 运行中，我们观察到放大区域之间的早期失衡，偏向负优势、负间隙的更新。它们的尾部 token 集中在少量响应片段中，随后不匹配扩散到全局。受这些发现启发，我们提出 TRIAGE，一种方向感知的稳定化方法：它使用片段级诊断选择性地重新平衡策略梯度更新，并对残留的严重不匹配实施有界修复。TRIAGE 修改优化目标，同时在 sampler 和 learner 上保留原生 NVFP4 权重与激活 4-bit（W4A4）前向执行。在 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-30B-A3B 上的实验显示，TRIAGE 在所评估的训练阶段内保持优化稳定，并在五个数学推理基准上达到全精度水平的性能；采用 TRIAGE 的原生 NVFP4 相比 BF16 最高可将 rollout 吞吐提升 2.3 倍。
items.author_line: Zhen Li, Shuai Zhang, Yanggan Gu, Yiming Zhang, Yang Yu, Mingfa Feng, Congkai Xie, Shuang Yu, Junjie Lai, Hongxia Yang

items.title: Valid for Free: Homophily-Gated Conformal Prediction for Training-Free Node Classification with Tabular Foundation Models
items.abstract_or_text: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) can classify the nodes of a graph without training on it, by reading node and neighborhood features as table rows next to labeled context rows. Work in this line reports predictive performance, not conformal coverage or prediction-set size. To our knowledge, we give the first reliability study of the setting, with TabICL as the TFM and half of each graph as labeled context. As for any predictor fixed before calibration, a frozen in-context predictor makes split conformal prediction exactly valid in finite samples, with no training, validation fold, or tuning on the target graph. An audit across ten graphs then shows that the training-free TabICL posterior has lower expected calibration error (ECE) than GCN with temperature scaling (GCN+TS) on nine of them. Its mean ECE over the ten graphs is 0.019, about 35 percent below the 0.029 of GCN+TS. We also introduce HG-DAPS, a training-free diffusion score whose homophily gate reads only the in-context labels, so the guarantee still holds. Relative to adaptive prediction sets (APS), it reduces mean set size by 5.8 to 17.1 percent on six homophilous graphs and changes it by under 1 percent on four heterophilous ones. On two binary, class-imbalanced graphs, a pre-registered trap case shows that gating on raw rather than adjusted homophily lowers coverage among low-homophily nodes by 0.27 and 0.12. Marginal coverage stays at the nominal 0.90 and masks this drop.
items.summary_zh: 研究 TabICL 在无需目标图训练的节点分类中的 conformal coverage 与预测集大小，并提出带同质性门控的 HG-DAPS。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 论文给出有限样本的 split conformal 有效性，并在十个图上报告校准误差、预测集大小和预注册陷阱案例，能检验可靠性而非只看准确率。
items.abstract_zh: 表格基础模型（TFM）可以在图上对节点进行分类，而无需在该图上训练：它把节点和邻域特征作为表格行，与带标签的上下文行一起输入。该方向的工作报告预测性能，却没有报告 conformal coverage 或预测集大小。据我们所知，我们给出了这一设置下的首个可靠性研究，使用 TabICL 作为 TFM，并将每个图的一半作为带标签上下文。对于任何在校准前固定的预测器，冻结的 in-context 预测器都能使 split conformal prediction 在有限样本中严格有效，无需在目标图上训练、验证折叠或调参。在十个图上的审计显示，训练免费的 TabICL 后验在其中九个图上的期望校准误差（ECE）低于带温度缩放的 GCN（GCN+TS）。十个图上的平均 ECE 为 0.019，约比 GCN+TS 的 0.029 低 35%。我们还提出 HG-DAPS，一种训练免费的扩散分数，其同质性门控只读取 in-context 标签，因此保证仍然成立。相较自适应预测集（APS），它在六个同质图上将平均预测集大小减少 5.8%—17.1%，在四个异质图上的变化低于 1%。在两个类别不平衡的二分类图上，一个预注册陷阱案例显示，按原始同质性而非校正后同质性进行门控，会使低同质性节点的 coverage 分别下降 0.27 和 0.12。边际 coverage 仍保持名义上的 0.90，并掩盖了这一下降。
items.author_line: Nguyen Duy Long, Phung Minh Hien, Nguyen Trong Viet, Nguyen Thai Anh

items.title: An AI-Assisted Formalization of the Poincaré Conjecture
items.abstract_or_text: We present an AI-assisted Lean 4 formalization of the Poincaré conjecture. The project began with limited reusable formal infrastructure for the geometric analysis behind the proof. To organize this work, we combined a proof blueprint prepared by mathematicians with explicit milestone statements. These milestones enabled parallel agent work and gave mathematicians clear points to locate blockers and provide effective mathematical guidance. Our analysis identifies the human interventions and organizational choices behind this workflow. The project provides a starting point toward reusable infrastructure for future formalization projects; such infrastructure, once developed, could eventually reduce the cost of verifying mathematical results in geometric analysis.
items.summary_zh: 项目报告 AI 辅助 Lean 4 形式化 Poincaré conjecture 的组织方式、里程碑和人工干预点，目标是建设几何分析形式化基础设施。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 公开摘要明确说明这是基础设施和工作流的起点，不能据此宣称模型独立完成了 Poincaré conjecture 的证明；其价值在于可审计的协作过程。
items.abstract_zh: 我们介绍一个 AI 辅助的 Lean 4 Poincaré conjecture 形式化项目。该项目开始时，可复用的几何分析证明基础设施非常有限。为组织这项工作，我们结合数学家准备的证明蓝图和明确的里程碑陈述。这些里程碑支持并行的智能体工作，也让数学家能够清楚定位阻塞点并提供有效的数学指导。我们的分析识别了这一工作流中的人工干预和组织选择。该项目为未来的形式化项目提供了一个起点；一旦相关基础设施建立起来，最终可能降低验证几何分析数学结果的成本。
items.author_line: Zhiyuan Zhang, Axel Delaval, Leheng Chen, Jinxuan Chen, Jie Xu, Yuxuan Liao, Jiedong Jiang, Chunlei Liu, Bin Dong

items.title: When Tools Lie: Reliability of Mathematical Agents Under Corrupted Tool Feedback
items.abstract_or_text: Mathematical problem solving often requires deterministic computational steps that agents delegate to tools and implicitly trust. Yet tools can fail silently, returning plausible but incorrect results. How well can agents detect and correct corrupted tool call outputs? We study this through a controlled corruption framework where a hidden interceptor replaces tool call results with plausible incorrect information on targeted problems. We evaluate agents across 31 problems under four verification designs including no verification (baseline), mandatory same-context reflection, optional fresh-context verification, and optional structural verification. Without verification, corruption causes dramatic accuracy loss, from 100% down to 72.4%. Mandatory reflection fully recovers this performance to 100%. Optional verification improves accuracy only when models actively invoke it. Our results show that checking frequency is strongly associated with robustness differences, while unequal invocation prevents a controlled comparison of verifier quality. A supporting recovery experiment shows that full problem restart succeeds in 100% of cases after explicit detection. These findings demonstrate that verifier availability and verification policy are separate components of mathematical-agent reliability. Mandatory policies enforce verification while optional policies depend on the model's own choice to invoke it.
items.summary_zh: 在 31 道数学题上人为注入可信但错误的工具反馈，比较无验证、强制反思和可选验证，显示验证政策决定代理鲁棒性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 受控破坏设置和四种验证设计使错误检测可重复；结果同时揭示可选验证依赖模型主动调用，不能简单等同于验证器本身可靠。
items.abstract_zh: 数学问题求解通常需要确定性的计算步骤，智能体会把这些步骤委托给工具并默认信任工具。然而，工具可能静默失效，返回看似合理但错误的结果。智能体能否发现并纠正被污染的工具调用输出？我们通过受控破坏框架研究这一问题：隐藏的拦截器会在目标问题上用看似合理的错误信息替换工具调用结果。我们在 31 道题上评估智能体，比较四种验证设计，包括无验证（基线）、强制同上下文反思、可选新上下文验证和可选结构验证。没有验证时，污染会使准确率从 100% 大幅降至 72.4%。强制反思可以将这一性能完全恢复到 100%。只有当模型主动调用验证时，可选验证才会提升准确率。我们的结果表明，检查频率与鲁棒性差异高度相关，而调用次数不相等会阻碍对验证器质量的受控比较。一个支持性恢复实验显示，在明确检测到错误后，完整重启问题可以在 100% 的案例中成功。这些发现说明，验证器是否可用与验证策略是数学智能体可靠性的两个独立组成部分。强制策略会执行验证，而可选策略取决于模型是否自行选择调用验证。

review.note: 从 60 项候选中选出 15 项，均达到质量分 70 及以上，且为公开 arXiv preprint；重点覆盖形式化证明、机器可检验验证、数学推理、ODE/物理求解器生成、理论分析与数学代理可靠性。未选入数学关联较弱或证据不足的候选。
